title: Container Report - Week 34
summary:
Container
It has been a week of mixed fortunes across the main FBX routes, as we have seen recent highs improve and some rates slipping on other trades. Bunker prices remain high, with no end in sight for the Straits of Hormuz situation, keeping rates firm as liner companies' price in the higher fuel costs into their customers rates. The Pacific loop trade lane FBX01 (China/East Asia - US West Coast) increased by $147 from last Friday ending the week at $7,569 and is up $1,475 since the start of the month.
